## About

My name is Darren Lin. I am a PhD student in the [Department of Biostatistics](https://ph.ucla.edu/departments/biostatistics) at the [University of California, Los Angeles](https://www.ucla.edu/). I previously received my BS in [Applied Mathematics and Statistics](https://engineering.jhu.edu/ams/) and [Public Health Studies](https://krieger.jhu.edu/publichealth/) and my ScM in [Biostatistics](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/departments/biostatistics) from [Johns Hopkins University](https://www.jhu.edu/). I am currently advised by [Dr. Falco J. Bargagli-Stoffi](https://www.falcobargaglistoffi.com/). My research interests lie in causal inference, with a focus on heterogeneous treatment effects, risk-benefit assessment, and the generalizability of clinical trial findings to broader populations.
